title: Use sidebar-owned controls and compact house-style pages
body: The owner explicitly prefers the adjacent legal-ai-app and foundation-e-learning shells over marketing-style dashboard copy. Keep collapse inside the left sidebar, theme switching at bottom-left, horizontal menu divider lines, and concise page/card titles without decorative subtitles or promotional sidebar cards. Pair related charts on desktop and stack on small screens. Retain functional data-quality notices and measured-zone coverage, rather than removing information needed to interpret health data.
